# Item 188 preparation package

**Verified local, 4 October 2026:** copied from the reviewed item 188 example. The original evidence/report remain unchanged.

Current public item: [UIST chapter](https://repository.uist.edu.mk/items/f3dfc719-25c6-498f-909f-1d746ac2833c).

| Current | Prepared target |
|---|---|
| Book chapter with one publication PDF | Keep the chapter; deposit this separate derived aggregate Dataset after review. |
| Survey results embedded in prose | 22 published percentages in CSV, source locators, README and dictionary. |
| Initialled creator fields | Verified full source-author names/affiliations/ORCIDs; responsible compiler remains to be named. |
| Existing chapter DOI/licence | Retain chapter rights; separate dataset identifier, documented version and confirmed package rights/access. |

[Website preview](preview.html) · [Metadata proposal](proposed_metadata.json) · [Release checks](release_checklist.md).

See the full [source investigation and current/proposed comparison](/Users/samil/uni_digital_repository/docs/eden/evidence/2026-10-04-item-188-dataset-example/comparison.md) for search coverage, licence distinction, source-study context, privacy/rights limits and UI/REST/OAI/JSON-LD observations. No participant records were reconstructed, and no original-author endorsement is claimed.

Stage is `prepared_needs_deposit`. Public dataset holdings and policy compliance remain unverified until normal acceptance and public release tests.
